fields.label: Payment Class
fields.description: Payment module code of the shop order (field payment_class), e.g. paypal, moneyorder (prepayment) or invoice. Not case-sensitive. See the setup guide for how to find it.

fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.description: ERPNext Mode of Payment used for the Payment Entry, e.g. 'PayPal' or 'Bank Transfer'. Only used if 'Paid at Checkout' is checked, when the invoice is submitted.

fields.label: Paid at Checkout
fields.description: Payment collected by the shop at checkout (e.g. PayPal). A Payment Entry dated on the order date is created when the invoice is submitted. Leave unchecked for methods paid later (e.g. prepayment by bank transfer).
